thesis: Strongest bear case is peak-cycle normalization plus unresolved GIS governance: global capacity can compress scarcity pricing while HDHE capex rises. Most other veto predicates are rebutted by net cash, backlog and diversification.

evidence.claim: H1 margin ~25% and utilization 88.8–95.1% are consistent with tight industry supply.
Bear DCF ~₩278k versus ₩725k price shows normalization downside.

counterevidence: Largest disclosed H1 customer is 15.9%, below 25% watch trigger.
falsifiers: If pricing/backlog and post-ramp utilization remain strong through 2028 and governance resolves favorably, red-team thesis weakens.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Adverse regulatory/procurement action exists in a collusion matter, but final judicial findings are unresolved.
Net cash and OCF rebut structural outside-capital dependence.
Mission-critical repeat demand and margins demonstrate customer value.
Current returns do not establish structural ROIC collapse.
Backlog/utilization/margins do not establish moat shrinkage.
